description: Permanently deletes an archived Trello card specified by its `idCard`.

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to be deleted. The card ID is a long alphanumeric string, while the shortLink is a shorter, unique identifier used in card URLs.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: delete_cards_by_id_card

DeleteCardsByIdCardResponse.description:
Response schema for `DeleteCardsByIdCard`.

Empty response body. The DELETE operation returns HTTP 200 OK with no content
upon successful deletion of the card. The official Trello OpenAPI specification
(developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/swagger.v3.json) defines this endpoint as
returning 200 Success but does not specify a response body schema. This is
consistent with other DELETE operations in the Trello API.
